name: PancakeSwap StableSwap
description: StableSwap on PancakeSwap is a feature to trade stable pairs with a lower slippage based on an invariant curve slippage function. It is designed to swap specific assets that are priced closely – such as USD stablecoin.

methodology.UserFees: User pays 0.25% fees on each swap.
methodology.Fees: All fees comes from the user fees, which is 0.25% of each trade.
methodology.Revenue: Revenue is 50% of the fees paid by users.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: A 40% of the fees is used to facilitate CAKE buyback and burn.
